Thanks for the clear asks. I put an initial MAP together and attached two artifacts for review (MAP spreadsheet + draft SIG answers). Highlights below so your auditors can see the handoffs at a glance:

- Evidence steward: Redwood will designate a single point of contact during the onramp window (Customer Success) and a separate legal owner for archived evidence. For now the CS contact during acceptance will be Kimberly Park (cc'd).
- SOC 2: we will provide the evidence index and a timeboxed access window for your auditors (read-only access to the evidence bundle). Evidence retention for staging/test accounts: default 90 days after acceptance, with a documented archival option for regulated customers.
- DPA annex: proposed wording in draft (will circulate). For EU residency we can provide region-specific test accounts; logs tied to EU accounts will be retained per the DPA annex and then purged per agreed retention schedule.

I've attached: RWI_MAP_Halcyon_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones and owners) and SIG-responses-draft.pdf (initial SIG/CAIQ answers). Please review and let us know where Legal wants tighter language.

Next steps I propose:
- Halcyon reviews MAP + SIG draft by 2027-08-11
- Redwood delivers DPA annex draft by 2027-08-12
- Finalize MAP and routing to procurement/legal by 2027-08-17

If those dates look tight, tell us your hard close date and we will compress.

Thanks — looping Kimberly to confirm stewarding plan.

Best,
Priyom Das\Solutions Lead, Evals & Onboarding\Redwood Inference

Hi Megan / team —

Quick clarifications from Security & Legal side: 

- Evidence stewardship: Customer Success (me) will be the operational steward during the MAP acceptance window; I will create a read-only evidence bundle and a short index that maps artifacts to SOC 2 control IDs (so your auditors can find what they need without asking for raw logs).

- Retention & deletion: for staging/test accounts we propose 90 days retention post-acceptance, with the following carveouts:
  * Audit logs (auth/authz events): retained 180 days for fraud/trace purposes, then deleted unless otherwise negotiated.
  * Full request/response traces that contain customer data: purged within 30 days of acceptance unless you request archival for compliance reasons.

- DPA annex (EU residency): attached draft with two options — (A) EU-hosted test accounts + logs physically stored in EU region for duration of evaluation; (B) EU data residency with log escrow on request (additional fee). Please review option A first — it's the fastest to operationalize.

- SIG/CAIQ: we've completed the majority of the questionnaire; redlines are expected around the encryption and key management section. I attached the DPA annex draft as a Word doc.

Action items I will take:
1) Finalize evidence index template and share by 2027-08-11.
2) Send DPA annex draft to Laura for legal redlines by 2027-08-12.
3) Stand up the EU test account (if you choose option A) within 5 business days of signoff.

Megan — if Halcyon requires longer retention for logs beyond the default windows, log the requirement and we'll route to pricing/legal for an annex.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park\Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
